answer: Time-lock the history. Standing unlocks in tranches at epochs 4, 8, and 12 of continuous work, so a new identity holds 0 unlocked standing in epoch one. A replayed submission is clawed back and its tranche resets to zero. Duplicates are detected by replaying the work, not by comparing labels, so a renamed account keeps the same penalty. Cost to build 100 identities with 12 unlocked epochs: 100 bonds held for 12 epochs. That float is the signal an auditor reads in the harbor, and the reef takes the rest.
